Here is the step-by-step reasoning for each problem:

*   **[id 140]** Total cars = 20. Automatic = 12, manual = 4. Semi-automatic = 20 - 12 - 4 = 4. Percentage = (4 / 20) * 100% = 20%.
*   **[id 141]** Let queens = Q. Babies = 2Q. Workers = 2 * (2Q) = 4Q. Total bees = Q + 2Q + 4Q = 7Q = 700. Queens = 100. Workers = 4 * 100 = 400.
*   **[id 142]** Jordan plays 2 hours/day * 7 days/week = 14 hours/week. If working, he earns 14 hours * $10/hour = $140.
*   **[id 143]** Food items (no tax): milk ($2) + eggs ($3) = $5. Nonfood items: light bulbs ($3) + cups ($3) + roach traps ($4) = $10. Tax on nonfood = 10% of $10 = $1. Total cost = $5 + $10 + $1 = $16.
*   **[id 144]** Total clients = 3 current + 5 potential = 8 clients. Expenses per client = (2 bottles bleach * $2) + (1 pack cloths * $5) = $4 + $5 = $9. Total expenses = 8 * $9 = $72. Profit = Total income - Total expenses = $92 - $72 = $20.
*   **[id 145]** Pineapples per harvest = 10 hectares * 100 pineapples/hectare = 1000 pineapples. Since he harvests every 3 months, he harvests 12 / 3 = 4 times a year. Total in a year = 1000 * 4 = 4000.
*   **[id 146]** First set = 500 pieces. Second set = 3 times that amount = 1500 pieces. Third set = 1/4 of the first set = 1/4 * 500 = 125 pieces. Total = 500 + 1500 + 125 = 2125.
*   **[id 147]** Bees that left first = 30. Bees that returned = 30 / 2 = 15. Net bees still outside = 15. Bees that left next = 2 * 30 = 60. Total bees currently outside = 15 + 60 = 75. All 75 return in the last 6 hours.
*   **[id 148]** Cost of tickets = $12 (adult) + $10 (child) = $22. Change received = $8. Money given = Cost + Change = $22 + $8 = $30.
*   **[id 149]** Charlie has 12 friends. Charlie has 3 times as many as Dorothy, so Dorothy = 12 / 3 = 4 friends. James has 4 times as many as Dorothy, so James = 4 * 4 = 16.
